notablePrerequisites: You have at least two artifact cards in hand.
description:
Activate Metalworker by tapping it, revealing at least two artifact cards from your hand and adding at least {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Activate Candelabra of Tawnos by paying {2} and tapping it, untapping it and Metalworker.
Repeat.
